affectedUses: Stabilizer for flavoring oils in fruit-flavored beverages

dates.complianceNote: Section VII specifies one year after the effective date; the calendar deadline is derived from that interval.

qualifications.text: Removes the former beverage stabilizer authorization, including brominated vegetable-oil variants described in response 3. The former 15 ppm finished-beverage limit is historical, not a current permission.

Response 1 states that BVO cannot be used in food without an authorizing food additive regulation or an applicable statutory exception, referring to FD&C Act section 201(s)(1)-(6). This event does not assert that any particular exception applies.
The one-year compliance period provides time to reformulate, relabel and deplete inventory. No further sell-through entitlement is established by this event.

evidence.scope: The final action and its dates and qualifications only; no scientific assessment or individual product determination.
limitations: Subsequent legal changes have not been exhaustively reconciled through the review date.
No EU status, verified CAS identifier or E-number is assigned.
